Gamma: Provider requested model levels must remain distinct effective identities under the frozen preflight and each live trial must recheck identity drift.

Nested Provider repeats do not increase independent n.
A calibration PASS is a difficulty-admission result, not a treatment-effect result.
No general model or Harness ranking is licensed by this claim specification.

verificationBridge.claimBoundary: Passing mechanical/design checks establishes only that the declared frozen three-family estimand was executed and analyzed according to its contracts; it does not establish general model intelligence or universal Harness superiority.
